description: Use this when someone asks whether a MERA RENT robot (Unitree G1, Unitree H2, Unitree Go2, Edward Warchocki or a catalog model) is free on a day or in a range of days. Returns each day as free, held (temporarily held by another request, may free up), busy, on_request (model without a public calendar), too_soon (under 2 days ahead) or beyond_calendar, plus the MERA RENT link for that robot and date. Reads only the public calendar: no client names or bookings. Free is not a reservation: MERA confirms the date after the booking request. Ranges up to 62 days. Not for prices (get_rental_quote) and it does not book (start_booking).

date_to.description: Optional last day of a range to check (up to 62 days from date).

lang.description: Language the person writes in (ISO 639, e.g. "en", "de", "pl"). The MERA RENT app has 24 languages; others get English.

robot.description: Robot id from MERA RENT, e.g. "g1" (Unitree G1), "h2" (Unitree H2), "go2" (Unitree Go2), "edward" (Edward Warchocki) or a catalog model such as "unitree-h1"; start_booking without a robot lists them.

name: check_availability
title: MERA RENT: is the robot free on this date?
